DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのようなメッセージが届きましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 応募した仕事の手数料として振り込むよう言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 応募後の手数料振込要求を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was told to transfer money as a fee for a job I applied for.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a transfer demand for fees after a job application. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 応募に使った窓口からの連絡ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is this contact from the place through which you applied?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: わかりません。仕事に応募した直後だったので、その会社だと思いかけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 連絡元不明で応募時期だけから同社と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not know. It was right after I applied, so I nearly assumed it was that company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the sender is unknown and you inferred the company only from application timing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 支払いはされていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。求人に記載された窓口へ、今回の要求を出したか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未払いで求人窓口へ要求の有無を確認すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I want to check with the contact in the job advertisement whether they made this demand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say no payment and you will verify the demand with the listed job contact. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相手が示した振込先や期限も残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you kept the recipient account and deadline they gave too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。今夜までと言われていますが、期限を理由に確認前の送金はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 急な期限でも未確認送金をしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. They say by tonight, but I will not transfer before checking just because of the deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say even an urgent deadline will not make you send unverified money. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談先をご案内します。求人そのものと今回の連絡を分けて説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain where to get advice. Please describe the job advertisement separately from this contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。応募済みだからこの請求も正しいとは言わず、求人とメッセージを両方示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 求人と今回メッセージを別資料として示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not claim this bill is valid just because I applied; I will show both the advertisement and message.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the job advertisement and this message as separate materials. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認した事実と要求の内容を分けて、担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Give the staff member the confirmed facts separately from the demand's contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この荷物を発送されますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、箱は大丈夫ですが、送り状を貼るときに少し破れてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 無傷の箱で送り状だけ破れたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The box is fine, but the shipping label tore a little while I was attaching it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the box is undamaged and only the shipping label is torn. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛先や番号が読めるか確認しましょう。新しい送り状は作れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check whether the address and number are readable. Can you make a new label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 作れます。箱が無傷ならそのまま送れると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 書換可能で箱無傷なら発送可と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I thought an undamaged box meant it could be sent as it was.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you can rewrite it and assumed an intact box meant shipping was possible. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 宛先をもう一度確認して、案内する方法で準備しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us confirm the destination again and prepare it using the method we explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。破れた部分を想像で書き足さず、相手からもらった住所を見て新しく書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 想像で補記せず実住所から新しく書くと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will not guess and fill in the torn part; I will write a new label using the address the recipient gave.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not reconstruct by guessing; write anew from the actual address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 古い送り状の扱いも受付で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check with the counter what to do with the old label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。二枚重ねて番号が二つ見える状態にはせず、どちらを使うか明確にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二番号が見えないよう旧送り状の扱い確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please help. I do not want to stack them with two numbers visible; I want it clear which one is being used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to handle the old label so two numbers are not visible. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しい記載ができたら、内容物と発送方法も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After the new entry is ready, we will check the contents and shipping method too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。箱の状態、送り状、内容物をそれぞれ確認してから受付をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱と送り状と内容物を別々に確認して受付を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Please accept it after separately checking the box condition, label, and contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for acceptance after separately checking box, label, and contents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。正しい送り状の準備をお手伝いし、発送条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will help prepare the correct label and check shipping conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込先の支店はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you identified the recipient branch?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この画面だと名前が途中までです。似た名前の二つのうち、上でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 略表示の似た二支店の上を選んでよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: On this screen the names are cut off. Of two similar names, may I choose the upper one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to choose the upper of two similarly abbreviated branch names. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示の順番だけで選ばず、案内の支店名や支店番号を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not choose by display order alone; check the branch name and number in the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内には正式な名前と番号があります。省略された名前だけで選ぼうとしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 正式名と番号があり略称のみで選びかけたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The instructions have the full name and number. I was about to choose using only the shortened name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have the official name and number but nearly chose by abbreviation alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それぞれの番号を照合できますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、上の番号は違います。名前が似ていても同じ支店とは扱いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 上の番号違いを示し同支店としない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. The upper number differs. I will not treat them as the same branch just because the names are similar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point out the upper number differs and do not treat it as the same branch. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一致する番号の候補を確認した後、ほかの情報も見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: After finding a candidate with a matching number, please review the other information too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 口座の種類と番号も、この案内に合わせて確認します。まだ送金はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未送金で種類と口座番号も照合すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check the account type and number against these instructions too. I have not sent money yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say no transfer and you will also compare account type and number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 最後の確認画面で受取人名も見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the recipient name on the final confirmation screen too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、違う名前が出た場合は実行せず、振込先へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取人名不一致なら送らず依頼元へ確認すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. If a different name appears, I will not execute; I will check with the transfer destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say a recipient-name mismatch means stopping and checking with the requester. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。省略表示の印象で選ばず、案内の情報を一つずつ照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Do not choose by impressions from shortened names; compare the instructions one item at a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お支払いは二千円です。まだお預かりしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your payment is two thousand yen. We have not received it yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません、財布を開いたところで電話を見て、もう払った気になっていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電話で気が散り財布開封を支払完了と誤解したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry, I looked at my phone after opening my wallet and felt I had already paid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that phone distraction made you mistake opening your wallet for completed payment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お金はまだお手元ですね。落ち着いてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You still have the money, correct? Please check calmly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、手に持ったままでした。払ったと主張せず、ここからお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙幣は手元でこれから渡すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I was still holding it. I will not insist I paid; I will hand it over now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you still hold the banknotes and will now give them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二千円ちょうど、お預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will take exactly two thousand yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。電話をしまって、支払いとレシートを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話をしまい受付金額とレシートを確認すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I will put my phone away and check the payment and receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put away your phone and check the received amount and receipt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋にはご自身で入れられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you bag the products yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、袋を持っています。会計した商品だけを受け取ったか見てから移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の袋があり購入商品の受取を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I have a bag. I will check that I received only the products I paid for before moving away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have your own bag and will check receipt of purchased products. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらがレシートです。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。今度は財布を開けただけではなく、店の受付と金額を確認してから支払い済みと考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今回完了を確認し開封だけで済と判断しないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have it. This time I will regard payment as complete only after confirming the store received the money and the amount, not just opening my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm this payment's completion and do not judge it done by opening a wallet alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。商品とレシートをお忘れなくお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please remember to take your goods and receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 出口へ向かわれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you heading to the exit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、柵の向こうに出口が見えます。このまま直線で行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 柵越しの出口へ直線で行けるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I can see it beyond the fence. Can I go straight there?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can go directly to an exit visible beyond a fence. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見える方向と通れる道は別です。柵を越えず、通路を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The direction you can see and a passable route are separate. Let us check the path without crossing the fence.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: わかりました。出口が近く見えるので近道と思いましたが、通れる道を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見える距離を近道と思ったと説明し通行路を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. It looked close, so I thought it was a shortcut, but please show me a usable path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that visible proximity seemed a shortcut and ask a permitted route. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今利用できる通路を案内します。遠回りになりますが、休憩は必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will show a currently usable passage. It is a detour; do you need a rest?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、途中で少し座りたいです。距離だけでなくベンチの場所も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 遠回りで休憩を希望しベンチ場所も聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I would like to sit briefly on the way. I want to check bench locations as well as distance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a rest on the detour and bench locations too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路沿いの休憩場所を確認します。出口の外はどちらへ行きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check rest spots along the path. Where will you go outside the exit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: バス停です。出口に着いたら終わりと思わず、その先の道も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 出口以降のバス停への道も求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The bus stop. I do not want to treat reaching the exit as the end; I need to know the onward path too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the route beyond the exit to the bus stop too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出口とバス停までの案内をお示しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will show directions to the exit and bus stop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。柵沿いを無理に進まず、案内された通路で休みながら戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 柵沿いの無理な移動をせず正規通路で戻ると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will not force my way along the fence; I will return along the guided path, resting as needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not force movement along the fence and will return via the proper path. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。利用できる経路と途中の案内に従ってお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13221-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please follow the usable route and signs along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運行状況を確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check operating conditions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、携帯に運休と届いたので、別の行き方を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 届いた運休情報で代替経路を探していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, my phone received a cancellation notice, so I am looking for another route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say a cancellation message led you to seek an alternative route. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その情報が届いた日と時刻はいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: When did that information arrive, date and time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方でした。今開いたので、今の連絡だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日の通知を今のものと思ったと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yesterday evening. I opened it now, so I thought it was a current message.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct that you mistook yesterday's notice for current information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の状況を確認しましょう。昨日の案内だけで今日は運休とは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the current situation. Yesterday's information alone does not show today's service is canceled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。別の経路を買う前に、今日の案内を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別切符を買う前に現在運行の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Before buying a different route, I want to know today's information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check current operation before buying another ticket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 目的地と希望の到着時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell us your destination and desired arrival time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十時にこの駅へ着きたいです。昨日の話ではなく、今からの移動としてお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日の目的地と到着期限を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to reach this station at ten. Please treat it as travel from now, not yesterday's situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give today's destination and arrival deadline. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在の候補を調べます。同行者にも運休と連絡していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check current options. Have you told your companion the train is canceled too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだです。昨日のメッセージを今日の情報として転送せず、確認した案内を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 過去通知を現情報として転送せず確認結果を知らせると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not yet. I will not forward yesterday's message as today's information; I will tell them the confirmed guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not forward an old notice as current; share the confirmed result. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。情報の日時と現在の列車を照合してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will compare the information's date and time with current trains and guide you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の日時はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Has your appointment date and time been decided?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この受付メールが来たので、明日相談できると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受付メールから翌日相談できると思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received this acceptance email, so I thought I could consult tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you assumed tomorrow's consultation from an acceptance email. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メールには予約確定とありますか、それともお問い合わせ受付ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does it say booking confirmed or inquiry received?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 問い合わせ受付です。希望日に明日と書いただけでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 問い合わせ受付で希望日を記しただけと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Inquiry received. I only wrote tomorrow as my preferred date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain it only acknowledges an inquiry with your preferred date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 回答と相談枠の確定は、まだ確認が必要ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then the reply and confirmation of a consultation slot still need checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、明日の枠が取れたとは言わず、返事の確認方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未確定を認め回答確認方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will not say I have tomorrow's slot; please tell me how to check the reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge it is unconfirmed and ask how to check the answer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当からの回答方法を確認します。来庁するまでに回答がない場合はどうしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check how the staff member replies. What will you do if no answer arrives before you would visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 日時が決まらないまま窓口へ行かず、担当へ状況を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日時未定のまま来庁せず状況確認すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not come without a decided date and time; I will ask the staff member about the status.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check status rather than visit with an undecided time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別の希望日もあれば伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also give another preferred date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 来週の月曜も可能です。問い合わせを何度も新規で送らず、この受付番号で相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 代替日を示し重複問い合わせせず既受付番号で相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Next Monday is possible too. I would like to use this acceptance number rather than submit repeated new inquiries.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give an alternative date and use the existing inquiry number without duplication. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。受付番号で現在の状況を確認し、相談日時の確定方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will check the current status by this number and explain how the consultation date and time are confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類のどの記載が気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which entry on the document concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 領収書の番号が診察券と違います。別の人の書類でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 領収書と診察券の番号相違を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The receipt number differs from my patient card. Is this someone else's document?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about differing receipt and patient-card numbers. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 患者番号なのか会計の整理番号なのか、見出しを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the heading to see whether it is a patient number or billing reference.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 領収書番号とあります。番号は全部同じになると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 領収書番号を全書類共通番号と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says receipt number. I thought all the numbers would be the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you thought the receipt number was common to every document. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号の意味を会計担当が説明します。お名前と受診日はご本人の情報ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The billing staff will explain its meaning. Are the name and visit date your own information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、名前と今日の日付は合っています。ただ、それだけで確認不要とはせず、番号の役割を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名前と受診日が一致しても番号の意味の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, the name and today's date match. But I do not want to treat that as needing no check; I want to ask each number's purpose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check the number's meaning even with matching name and visit date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認します。この領収書は何かの申請に使われますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check. Will this receipt be used for an application?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 使います。申請欄に診察券の番号を求められたら、領収書の番号を代わりに書かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 申請で別番号を代用しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. If the application asks for my patient card number, I will not write the receipt number instead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not substitute a different number on an application. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 申請欄の条件は提出先にも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the application field's conditions with the submission destination too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。病院の番号の意味をここで確認し、提出する欄の指定は提出先へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号説明と提出欄指定の相談先を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will check the hospital numbers' meaning here and ask the destination what its submission field specifies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish whom to ask about number meanings and submission-field requirements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。書類の記載内容を確認し、それぞれの番号を区別してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will check the document entries and explain each number separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような袋をなくされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What kind of bag did you lose?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 白い袋に書類を入れていました。掃除で捨てた袋と同じ色です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 書類入り袋と捨てた袋が同色と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A white bag with documents inside. It is the same color as the bag I threw away while cleaning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the document bag and discarded bag were the same color. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: なくした袋を捨てたことは確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you confirmed that you threw away the missing bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、捨てたのは空の袋だと思いますが、中身を確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 中身未確認で対象を捨てたとは断定できないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I think the discarded one was empty, but I did not check inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the contents were unchecked and you cannot conclude the missing bag was discarded. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後に書類入りの袋を見たのはいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: When did you last see the bag containing documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日、机の横に置いたときです。捨てたと決めつけず、その後の経過を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最後の自宅目撃と未確定の処分を分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yesterday when I put it beside the desk. I want to explain the later sequence rather than assume it was thrown away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate the last sighting at home from uncertain disposal. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 外へ持ち出した可能性はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is there a possibility you took it outside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は別の袋で出勤しました。なくした袋を外で見た覚えはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日の別袋使用と屋外目撃なしを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I used another bag for work today. I do not remember seeing the missing bag outdoors.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you used another bag today and have no memory of the missing one outside. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 自宅の確認と、届け出について分けて伺います。書類の特徴は説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will ask about checking at home separately from a report. Can you describe the documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、封筒が二つ入っています。詳しい個人情報は人前で広げず、必要な範囲でお伝えしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内部封筒の特徴と個人情報を限って説明したい希望を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, two envelopes inside. I would like to give detailed personal information only as necessary, without spreading it out in public.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe the internal envelopes and your wish to limit personal-information disclosure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認できている置き場所、掃除の経過、袋の特徴を整理して相談を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will organize the confirmed placement, cleaning sequence, and bag features while hearing your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票の手続きをお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the procedure on a missed-delivery notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、店の注文ボタンをもう一度押せば、再配達になると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 販売店の再注文ボタンを再配達と思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I thought pressing the shop's order button again would arrange redelivery.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you mistook a shop reorder button for redelivery. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 販売店への新しい注文と、この荷物の再配達は別です。ボタンは押しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: A new shop order is different from redelivery of this parcel. Have you pressed the button?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。新しい注文が増える前に、この不在票の手続きを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未操作で新規注文前に不在票手続を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. Before adding a new order, I want to ask the procedure for this missed-delivery notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not operated it and want the notice procedure before a new order. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 不在票の番号で状況を確認します。受け取れる日時はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check status using the notice number. When can you receive it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 明日の夕方です。選べる時間帯を確認して、私が在宅できる枠で申し込みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 在宅可能日時を示し受付枠を選びたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Tomorrow evening. I want to check available slots and apply for one when I can be home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give your available time and wish to select an accepted slot. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受付可能な枠を案内します。販売店には連絡されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will show available slots. Have you contacted the shop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 注文はし直していません。必要なら発送済みの同じ注文について問い合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 再注文せず既発送の同注文として問い合わせると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not ordered again. If necessary, I will inquire about the same order already shipped.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not reorder and will inquire about the existing shipped order. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 再配達の申し込み後には、結果を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the result after requesting redelivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、販売店の注文履歴ではなく、不在票の再配達の完了内容を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 注文履歴と再配達完了結果を分けて確認すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will check the completed redelivery details for this notice, not the shop's order history.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check order history separately from the redelivery completion result. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。この荷物の手続きをご案内し、新しい注文とは分けて進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will explain this parcel's procedure and proceed separately from a new order.
